title: Lake Victoria Basin (Kenya)
description: Datasets registered under the 'Lake Victoria Basin (Kenya)' Living Landscape (2 item(s)). Spatial extent derives from the canonical landscape delineation (2026-07-21); the boundary geometry is not redistributed here because its licence does not allow it; the 'boundary-source' asset names the source. National-coverage member items can widen the extent beyond the boundary.
mosaic:bbox_note: Bbox derived from the canonical delineation shapefile (dissolved, EPSG:4326), union-ed with member-item locator boxes.
